title: Hardware & Component Supply Master Agreement
description: Multi-page manufacturing and hardware procurement contract with firm fixed pricing and high volume commitment.

payment_terms.quote: Payment shall be due under payment terms of Net 45 calendar days after receipt of goods.

price_adjustment.quote: Unit prices are firm and fixed for the entire 48-month duration with no price increases.

contract_term.quote: The initial term of this Agreement shall be 48 months from the Effective Date.

auto_renewal.quote: This Agreement shall not automatically renew upon expiration of the initial term.

termination_notice.quote: Either party may terminate for convenience upon written notice of at least 60 days.

liability_cap.quote: Each party's total aggregate liability under this agreement shall not exceed $5,000,000 USD.

governing_law.quote: This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of California, without regard to conflicts principles.

volume_commitment.quote: Buyer guarantees a minimum volume commitment of 10,000 accelerator units per calendar year.
